input.variant: Neuropixels 1.0; only pinned BTS-NPX1-R1 engineering map accepted
input.signal: named inert synthetic source revision, DC offset ±100 µV, sine amplitude 0–80 µV, slope ±0.05 µV/µm, frequency 0.5–80 Hz, 100–1,000 ms
input.selection: bank 0/1 up to channel 383; bank 2 up to channel 191. These are virtual channel indexes, not true device routing. Display Y shift ±5000 µm.

output.records: selected site's synthetic voltage/clock, all selected-bank sites at t=0, stable site and sample IDs, local and shifted coordinates, geometry hash. CSV is selected trace only.
output.units: s, V, µm; 1 ms time step

failures: Wrong variant or map revision, malformed or changed geometry file, unsupported bank/channel and invalid fixture ranges reject output.
limits: No biology, anatomy, insertion, live recording, stimulation, electrical routing, hardware configuration, signal calibration, reconstruction of the films/impedance or native headset session. Only view translation.
